additional_authenticated_data.Description: The additional authenticated data used for integrity checks during encryption and decryption.

ciphertext.Description: Contains the result of encrypting the provided plaintext, encoded in base64.

crypto_key.Description:
The full name of the CryptoKey that will be used to encrypt the provided plaintext.
Format: ''projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/keyRings/{{keyRing}}/cryptoKeys/{{cryptoKey}}''
